intent: Vendored app-automation stack for action-to-app execution. Source code is intended to live under each target_dir so future platform revisions can patch vendored implementations directly.

selected_tools.name: Activepieces
selected_tools.license: MIT for Community Edition; commercial license for enterprise features
selected_tools.notes: Primary connector/workflow base. Pieces can become MCP tools; keep custom pieces patchable in-tree.

selected_tools.name: Composio
selected_tools.notes: Broad app API toolkit/auth bridge. Use when API-backed app execution is more reliable than browser automation.

selected_tools.name: Model Context Protocol reference servers
selected_tools.license: Apache-2.0 for new contributions; existing code under MIT per upstream repository
selected_tools.notes: Reference implementations and MCP contract examples. Treat as examples first, production only after hardening.

selected_tools.name: n8n
selected_tools.license: Sustainable Use License / n8n Enterprise License
selected_tools.notes: Powerful workflow engine. License must be reviewed before redistributing modified vendored source.

selected_tools.name: Stagehand
selected_tools.notes: TypeScript browser-agent layer. Use for web apps when API/MCP coverage is absent or insufficient.

selected_tools.name: Browser Use
selected_tools.notes: Python browser-agent runtime. Useful fallback for natural-language browser tasks.

selected_tools.name: Skyvern
selected_tools.license: AGPL-3.0 core; upstream managed-cloud exceptions noted by project
selected_tools.notes: Use for brittle websites and visual interaction. AGPL obligations require explicit review before redistribution.
